resetCast.title: Reset Cast
resetCast.message:
This restarts the casting process for the selected instances and interrupts their current casts.
The device will run kill -9 $(pidof hwcodec) to restart its encoder.
Use this when a cast is frozen or stuck on loading.

batchCast.title: Batch cast notice
batchCast.message:
Casting uses some device resources; casting too many may pressure devices.
1. If casting lags, check container and device resource usage.
2. High CPU load causes stream stutter; reduce the number of casts as needed.
3. Brief black screen on a device during heavy batch casting is normal—please wait, as starting many devices at once is demanding.
